rubric_hint.rule: 1 eligible species recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m, none within 250 m
rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: One eligible species, Goodyera repens (VU, site-bound, felling factors incl. lack of dead wood), recorded 124 times; nearest 501 m away (2026, unc 5 m). That is beyond 250 m but within 1000 m.
No records of any kind inside or within 250 m of the 0.92 ha polygon.
Effort within 1000 m is 218-ish records (218 kept, 218 in effort figure of the 1000 m ring), above the county median of 66, so the near-site gap is not clearly explained by low effort overall.
Several site-bound forest NT fungi, moss and lichen records lie 585-938 m away, supporting context only. The NT species within 250 m count is 0.
Completed felling overlaps only 5.1% of the polygon (a 2005 felling).
Regeneration felling notified on 0.92 ha, status notified.

uncertainties: The eligible record is about 500 m away; it does not show that the species occupies the polygon.
The polygon is small (equivalent radius 54 m), and zero records within 250 m could reflect where people happened to record, not what is there.
not_established: Does not establish that any threatened species occurs on the polygon.
Absence of records near the site is not absence of species.
Does not show the site is safe to fell.
next_action: A reviewer should check whether the habitat on the small polygon resembles the Goodyera repens locations 500 m away, and consider a field check before felling starts.
